items.title: OmniHandwritingOCR: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Evaluating Multimodal LLMs in Handwritten OCR Scenarios
items.summary_1line: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly used as OCR systems in document and knowledge-processing pipelines, but their ability to faithfully read real handwriting remains underexplored. Existing OCR b...
items.editor_note: First of the three: isolates handwriting-OCR failures in multimodal LLMs used in document pipelines.

items.title: KC-Bench: A Dynamic Interactive Benchmark for Evaluating Knowledge Conflicts in LLM Agents
items.summary_1line: As LLMs increasingly act through tools, they must reconcile user instructions, parametric knowledge, and dynamic environmental observations before taking actions. We introduce KC-Bench, a controlled multi-turn benchma...
items.editor_note: Second: a multi-turn benchmark for agents reconciling instructions, memory, and live tool output.

items.title: AWS-bench: Benchmark for evaluating AI coding agents on real-world AWS tasks
items.summary_1line: AWS-bench: Benchmark for evaluating AI coding agents on real-world AWS tasks
items.editor_note: Third and newest: an open-source benchmark grading coding agents on real AWS tasks.

editorial.tldr: Researchers keep shipping narrow, domain-specific benchmarks instead of one general leaderboard. Since Aug 19, that's produced a handwriting-OCR diagnostic for multimodal models and a knowledge-conflict test for tool-using agents.
editorial.whats_new: AWS-bench landed Sep 4 as an open-source benchmark scoring AI coding agents against real AWS infrastructure tasks, not synthetic coding puzzles.
editorial.why_it_matters: A general coding leaderboard rank doesn't predict whether an agent can safely operate real cloud infrastructure — pick the benchmark that matches your deployment surface.
editorial.take_for_builders: If you're picking a coding agent for AWS-specific work, run it against AWS-bench before trusting a general coding leaderboard rank.

beats.headline: OmniHandwritingOCR probes multimodal LLMs on real handwriting
beats.summary: A diagnostic benchmark for handwritten-OCR fidelity in document and knowledge-processing pipelines.

beats.headline: KC-Bench tests how agents resolve conflicting instructions and knowledge mid-task
beats.summary: A controlled multi-turn benchmark for reconciling user instructions, parametric knowledge, and live tool observations.

beats.headline: AWS-bench scores coding agents on real-world AWS tasks
beats.summary: An open-source benchmark built specifically around AWS infrastructure tasks rather than generic coding problems.

open_questions: Does AWS-bench cover multi-service, compound infrastructure tasks or only single-service actions?
Will model vendors start reporting scores against these narrow benchmarks, or will they stay community-only?
